This pair of cast stone hunting dogs is based on an original 19th century iron sculpture. The original would have been done by a French “Animalier”, which was an artist that specialized in painting or sculpting realistic portrayals of animals.  The large dogs seen here are in a seated position, resting on elliptical bases. The first dog is collarless with the collar laying on the ground beneath one of the forepaws.
